name: Benjamin Netanyahu
quote: We're in possession of 60% of the Gaza Strip's territory. My directive is to move to 70%. We are fighting until victory — until Hamas is destroyed and Gaza is demilitarized.

name: Yahya Sinwar
quote: We have broken the barrier of fear. What happened will shake the consciousness of all of Palestine.

name: Ismail Haniyeh
quote: We will not stop until we achieve our legitimate rights and the liberation of our land.

name: Joe Biden
quote: Israel has the right to defend itself and its people — full stop. But it also matters how Israel does it.

name: Donald Trump
quote: We're going to hit them extremely hard over the next two to three weeks. Israel will do what I tell them — they will stop when I stop.

name: Antony Blinken
quote: We have been very clear that Israel must do much more to protect civilian lives and ensure humanitarian assistance gets to those who need it.

name: António Guterres
quote: The UN is cooperating with the Board of Peace initiative to fund and deliver the basics of Gaza reconstruction — but 93% of the 2026 humanitarian appeal remains unfunded. Gaza cannot wait.

name: Karim Khan
quote: The law must apply equally. No one is above the law — these warrants reflect my independent obligation to apply the law.

name: Yoav Gallant
quote: We are fighting human animals and we act accordingly. Gaza will not return to what it was.

name: Gen. Herzi Halevi
quote: I bear responsibility for what happened on October 7. There is no escaping it.

name: Mohammed Odeh
role: Hamas Qassam Brigades Commander (KIA May 26, 2026 — IDF/Shin Bet airstrike, Rimal neighborhood, Gaza City — 4th Qassam chief killed since Oct 7; killed 11 days after predecessor al-Haddad)
quote: The resistance will not bow — every commander who falls will be replaced until liberation is achieved.

name: Izz al-Din al-Haddad
role: Hamas Gaza Military Wing Chief (KIA May 16, 2026 — IDF airstrike, Gaza City, Day 6 of renewed campaign)
quote: The military wing of the resistance does not negotiate its weapons — every martyr strengthens our resolve.

name: Mohammed Sinwar
role: Hamas Gaza Military Commander (KIA May 13, 2026 — tunnel beneath European Hospital, Khan Yunis)
quote: The resistance will continue until liberation and the return of our prisoners.

name: Mahmoud Abbas
quote: These elections are a democratic milestone — they demonstrate that Palestinians can self-govern under the rule of law, and that the Palestinian Authority is the legitimate representative of our people.

name: Itamar Ben Gvir
role: Israeli National Security Minister (Otzma Yehudit) — Travel-banned by France, Poland, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium (May 2026) over flotilla activist mistreatment; Italy leading push for EU sanctions
quote: We need to encourage emigration from Gaza. We should take over Gaza and send the terrorists to hell.

name: Bezalel Smotrich
role: Israeli Finance Minister (Religious Zionism) — ICC arrest warrant sought May 19, 2026
quote: This is a declaration of war against the State of Israel. I will fight back with a vengeance. I have signed the order to evacuate Khan al-Ahmar. The ICC cannot stop us from defending our rights.

name: Benny Gantz
role: Israeli War Cabinet Member / Opposition Leader (resigned Jun 2024)
quote: If by June 8 there is no strategic plan for what happens the day after, we will leave the government.

name: Cyril Ramaphosa
quote: South Africa has gone to the ICJ because we cannot allow this destruction and killing of Palestinians to continue. We are committed to the principles of international law.

name: Francesca Albanese
role: UN Special Rapporteur on Palestinian Territories
quote: This is not a war against Hamas. This is a genocide against the Palestinian people.

name: Pramila Patten
role: UN Special Representative on Sexual Violence in Conflict
quote: There are clear and convincing information that sexual violence occurred during the 7 October attacks in multiple locations.

name: Philippe Lazzarini
quote: 391 of our colleagues have been killed — more UN staff than in any conflict in UN history. We are calling for a formal investigation. There must be accountability.

name: Abdel Fattah el-Sisi
quote: We reject any attempt to liquidate the Palestinian cause by forcing Palestinians into Egypt. This is a red line.

name: Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani
quote: Qatar has consistently worked toward a ceasefire and the release of all hostages and detainees through diplomatic channels.

name: Hassan Nasrallah
quote: The front in Lebanon is and will remain open in support of Gaza until the aggression on Gaza stops.

name: Nickolay Mladenov
role: Board of Peace Director General (UN/Int'l envoy)
quote: Hamas is tightening its grip and blocking reconstruction. The ceasefire hinges entirely on Hamas disarmament — that obligation is not negotiable. You cannot build a future with armed groups running the streets. We are now moving forward with governance and reconstruction in the areas of Gaza that Hamas does not control.

name: Mike Waltz
role: US Ambassador to the United Nations (2025–Present)
quote: Hamas must decommission its weapons for Gaza to be rebuilt. There is no path to reconstruction that runs through a rearmed Hamas.

name: JD Vance
quote: The war will continue a little while longer. We're committed to ensuring Israel can finish what needs to be finished before any sustainable peace is possible.

name: Amos Hochstein
quote: The ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon gives both peoples the opportunity to return to their homes and live in security.

name: Brett McGurk
role: US National Security Council (Biden Middle East Coordinator)
quote: We have been working around the clock on a deal that would bring the hostages home and establish a sustainable ceasefire.

name: Volker Türk
role: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights
quote: Palestinians across Gaza are unsafe six months on from the ceasefire announcement. Israel's continued daily strikes constitute ceasefire violations — the killing must stop, and those responsible must be held accountable.

name: Khaled Khiari
role: UN Assistant Secretary-General for Middle East, Asia and Pacific
quote: The ceasefire is increasingly fragile. 824 Palestinians, including more than 200 children, and 7 humanitarian workers have been killed since the ceasefire took effect. 1.8 million people remain displaced and dependent on aid. Phase 2 talks have produced no agreement.

name: Pedro Sánchez
quote: Israel is once again violating international law by attacking a civilian flotilla in waters that do not belong to it. I am calling on the EU to suspend its association agreement with Israel.

name: Hakan Fidan
quote: We are in Doha to prevent a humanitarian catastrophe. Any resumption of war in Gaza will be devastating for the Palestinian people and destabilizing for the entire region. Turkey will not remain silent in the face of this.

name: Khalil al-Hayya
role: Hamas New Gaza Leader (appointed May 17, 2026) & Lead Ceasefire Negotiator — Doha-based, $750K US bounty, Hebrew-speaking
quote: The resistance is not negotiating its weapons or its right to exist. Any deal must guarantee the full withdrawal of Israeli forces and the right of return of all displaced Palestinians.

name: Roman Gofman
role: Mossad Director (from June 2, 2026) — former deputy director; appointment cleared by Supreme Court June 1; inherits agency that killed 5 Hamas senior leaders since Oct 7
quote: We will continue pursuing those who threaten Israel's security — the long arm of Israel will reach them wherever they are.
